stance: Growth: Q3 advance GDP printed 3.4% SAAR, up from 2.2% in Q2. Spending is strong (September retail sales +0.77% m/m; core capex orders +0.46%). CARTS October ex-auto nominal +1.0% m/m (unconfirmed, one source) points to firm retail sales ahead. September trade deficit -105.0bn. October ISM services verified at 54.5 (54.9 Sep), new orders 55.9 (59.8). ISM manufacturing PMI 55.5 is unconfirmed. Watch CARTS confirmation, Census retail control group, core capex, later GDP.
